note: Cost and coverage for the first full whole-track re-scan. The analyser was driven by constructing File objects from bytes served on a loopback port, because showDirectoryPicker is a native dialog that cannot be automated. That the ids match a real folder pick is proven by the store staying at 219 records: the 179 overwrote in place rather than adding new keys.

cost.excludes: disk read (harness bytes were already in memory) and the directory walk

memory.instrument: renderer process working set sampled from OUTSIDE the browser every 250ms. performance.memory cannot see the decoded AudioBuffer or the Essentia WASM heap, and the analysis blocks the main thread so nothing in-page can sample a peak.
memory.verdict: bounded by the longest single track, not by library size - peak did not climb across the pass
